spanish: Y darás al pectoral del juicio las luces y las perfecciones, y serán sobre corazón de Aarón en su entrar delante de Jehová, y alzará Aarón el juicio de hijos de Israel sobre su corazón delante de Jehová siempre.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration "joshen" with "pectoral", the common-noun sense of חֹשֶׁן (H2833, construct).
Replaced "los urim" with "las luces", the common-noun sense of הָאוּרִים (H224, definite masculine plural); article changed to feminine to agree with the Spanish noun.
Replaced "los tumim" with "las perfecciones", the common-noun sense of הַתֻּמִּים (H8550, definite masculine plural); article changed to feminine to agree with the Spanish noun.
readerNote: Chose the literal common-noun gloss for הָאוּרִים/הַתֻּמִּים (lights/perfections) rather than a transliteration, since the audit confirmed these are common nouns, not proper names.
